statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-50195 affects containerd release lines using the github.com/containerd/containerd/v2 Go module path. The subject is the major-v1 module github.com/containerd/containerd at v1.7.33. Go modules with major versions two and later use distinct module paths, so the affected /v2 code is not present in this package version.
